workload: Built-in original demo, serial renderer, interpreter, muted, CRT off, no memory cards, 150% scale, visible 1280x900 logical px windows. Default allocator RSS is separate from gperftools live heap.
excluded: One debugger heap run lost focus; excluded. Intermediate implementation runs, including one retaining an extra RGB frame, excluded.

snapshot_benchmark.inline_size_note: Inline sizes include child structs but exclude heap buffers. Do not add parent and child sizes.

gpu_diagnostic.note: One extra native Console process per build, two samples five seconds apart; GPU residency accounting can include shared allocations and must not be added to RSS.
